# Descriptions
@@ 1
For the duration of this spell, all within the area of effect (including the
caster) may make a second RR versus any fear or panic effect. This second RR
is made with an additional +10 modifier.
@@ 2
Caster inspires all allies who are within the area of effect (they must be
aware of the caster). All allies gain +5 to melee attacks and moving manuevers
for the duration of the spell. This spell will only work during combat or
highly religious moments (e.g., an oratory presentation prior to a large
battle). These bonuses do not apply to the caster.
@@ 3
For as long as they speak together, the target of this spell will believe that
the caster is a good friend and is acting in the target’s best interest.
@@ 4
As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +10.
@@ 5
For as long as the caster speaks, the target will beleve that the reasoning
and ideas that the caster expresses are correct and valid.
@@ 6
As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +15.
@@ 7
For as long as the caster speaks, the target will become more cautious (less
rash) and will tend to obey the caster's warnings without hesitation or doubt.
@@ 8
Target must obey the caster. However, he will not perform any act that is
completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself
suggestions, etc.).
@@ 9
As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +20.
@@ 10
As Voice of Friendship, except will affect all who can hear the caster.
@@ 11
As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +25.
@@ 13
As Command I, except affects two targets.
@@ 14
As Voice of Reason, except will affect all who can hear the caster.
@@ 15
As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +30.
@@ 16
As Courage, except the second RR automatically succeeds.
@@ 17
As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +35.
@@ 18
As Voice of Caution, except will affect all who can hear the caster.
@@ 19
As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +40.
@@ 20
[RR Mod: -50] After casting this spell, the caster must tell the truth (as he
knows it). All targets who fail their RR will believe the caster is speaking
the absolute truth.
@@ 25
As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +50.
@@ 30
As Voice of Conviction, except will affect all who can hear the caster.
@@ 50
Caster can use any lower level spell from this list once per round.
